A short guide to supply orders for a steady week
This page is for you
Companion Animal Travel Desk support for pet travel

Aurelia Skyways keeps companion animal travel organized by making the first steps clear. Our operations team treats each journey as a shared responsibility, so travelers can prepare with confidence and keep their plans moving smoothly.

When you arrange travel with the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the usual goal is to confirm the pet's needs, the approved carrier, and the airport handoff process before departure. A steady plan helps reduce last-minute confusion and gives the traveler, the animal, and the ground team the same expectations.

If you are preparing a trip for a pet, gather the basic documents and make sure the carrier is clean, secure, and sized appropriately. It also helps to pack familiar comfort items that are allowed, since a familiar scent can make the trip calmer for the animal. Keep food and medication guidance ready if the pet has special needs, and follow the instructions provided by the travel team.

For some routes, the skyport uses operational limits that affect acceptance and handling. <<FACT F008>> Travelers should still submit the usual details early so the desk can review the request against current conditions and advise on the best next step. If space is limited, the team will guide you toward the safest option available.

Before airport arrival, check that the pet is healthy enough to fly and that all required paperwork matches the booking. The Companion Animal Travel Desk can also help you confirm how the animal should be presented at check-in and what to expect during transfer. Clear preparation makes the day easier for everyone involved.

If your plans change, notify the desk as soon as possible so the file can be updated and the support team can adjust the handling plan. Even small updates can matter when animals are moving through a shared airport workflow.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support and ask for the latest travel guidance.
